svg.title: Trajectory error against the closed-form solution, by integrator
svg.desc: Distance between the simulated and the exact position of the pendulum's outer link, as a percent of the arm's reach, over 10 seconds at a 2 ms step. The exact trajectory is the closed-form equations of motion integrated to 1e-13 tolerance. RK4 starts around 1e-6 percent and implicit midpoint around 1e-5; Verlet and Euler start near 1e-2 percent. Because the pendulum is chaotic, every run eventually separates from the exact path.
svg.text: outer-link position error (% of reach, log scale)
